title: Serre vanishing for a proper morphism
statement: Let $A$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\mathcal L$ be an ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module]. There exists $n_0\ge0$ such that $H^p(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})=0$ [pqf-def-cohomology] for every $p>0$ and $n\ge n_0$; the tensor product and the tensor power are those of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 02O1 (coherent-lemma-kill-by-twisting), specialized to an affine base; Morphisms Lemma 01VK (morphisms-lemma-ample-over-affine) identifies absolute and relative ampleness over an affine base.

proof.text: Properness gives local finite type over Spec A and hence local Noetherianity of X. Coherence gives quasi-coherence by the locally Noetherian equivalence. On every affine open coherent_affine_sections_finite gives finite sections; Noetherianity of the section ring and Module.finitePresentation_of_finite give finitely presented sections. quasicoherent_finite_type_affine and locality over all affine opens then give F.IsFinitePresentation.

Apply IsAmple.exists_immersion_affine_base to obtain d>0, N and i into projective space over Spec A, with L^d identified with tensorPullback i of O(1). Separatedness of the projective structure morphism and IsProper.of_comp make i proper; its image is closed, so IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion makes i a closed immersion.

Induction identifies positiveTensorPower with tensorPow. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensorPullback with pullback, so L.tensorPow d is isomorphic to twistRestrict i 1. For each r:Fin d, tensor-product finiteness and quasi-coherence allow the closed-immersion twist-vanishing theorem to be applied to F tensor L.tensorPow r, giving a bound t_r independent of the positive degree.

Set n0=d*sum_r t_r. For n>=n0 write r=n%d and t=n/d, so n=r+d*t and t>=sum_r t_r>=t_r. The tensorPow addition and multiplication isomorphisms, pullback tensor-power comparison, and O(1)^t=O(t) give an isomorphism F tensor L^n ≅ (F tensor L^r) tensor twistRestrict i t. Map this isomorphism through moduleCohomology and transport IsZero from the residue bound.
